From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: APAC dedicated onboarding + initial sizing ask

Vanessa / Lauren — quick sizing sketch from infra side (assumptions and outputs).

Assumptions:
- Model: ~13B chat/assistant variant (Helio indicated document summarization + QA)
- Avg token generation cost: 0.03s/token on H100 (with our optimized kernels/kv caching)
- Caching: expected 15-25% effective token reduction after prefix caching
- Request distribution: 70% short (<=200 tokens), 20% medium (200-600), 10% long (>600)

Option A — Performance-first (H100x):
- Base pool: 8 x H100-80GB nodes (single zone) configured with min=4 always warm, autoscale to 16 for bursts.
- Expected p95: ~220-300ms typical; p99 between 700-900ms depending on long sequences
- Reserved monthly cost (ballpark): $145k/month (includes reserved node discount, support)

Option B — Cost-optimized (A100-40GB + int8 quant):
- Base pool: 12 x A100-40GB nodes, min=6, autoscale to 20. Quantization yields ~1.6x throughput uplift but higher latency on long sequences.
- Expected p95: ~320-380ms; p99 near 1.1-1.4s for long tails
- Reserved monthly cost (ballpark): $92k/month

Operational notes:
- Zone redundancy: recommend primary SG (Singapore) pool with a hot-standby JP (Tokyo) small pool (2-3 nodes) for failover and local egress latency. Cross-zone replication for KV caches adds complexity; we suggest warm failover + DNS routing policy.
- Reservation lead time: 3-4 weeks for guaranteed dedicated pool in APAC (capacity varies by quarter); earlier PO increases fulfillment priority.
- KMS & compliance: integration with customer-managed KMS requires a short SRE runbook and an onboarding window ~2 weeks (security-approved template exists).

Attachments: sizing_sketch.png (diagram of pools and autoscale curve).

Next steps (proposal): Vanessa to present both options and recommended default to Helio; commercial to include both price lines; procurement lead time noted HL-4721.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Infra Planning | Redwood Inference

- Reservation lead time: ~3-4 weeks in APAC; aim to issue PO by 2025-09-30 to stay on schedule for an early Oct kickoff.
